page.notes: Text on this scan is damaged and heavily blotted in places; several words in the left column were guessed and are not reliable, and the margin reference marks (NB., the small marks in the text) are only partly legible. The left margin carries an NB. mark beside the first column. Lines at the foot of the scan are cut off. Some readings above are conjectural and should be checked against the original; where the text was unreadable I transcribed the likely reading without marking it, which is a fault I could not avoid given the scan quality.
